lines.zh: 我走过的地方，小树会弯下去。
lines.en: Where I walk, the small trees bend.

lines.zh: 我的木角刮着树冠，叶子落了一路。
lines.en: My wooden horns scrape the canopy, and leaves fall behind me.

lines.zh: 丛林太潮，我的鳞上挂着水。
lines.en: The jungle is so damp my scales hang with water.

lines.zh: 我一步踩碎两根藤，也不在意。
lines.en: I crush two vines a step and pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 我沿着林间空地走，避开大树。
lines.en: I keep to forest clearings, sparing the great trees.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫过蕨丛，惊起一片虫。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the ferns and scatters a cloud of insects.

lines.zh: 泥土被我压出深深的脚印。
lines.en: The soil takes deep prints from my weight.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，是因为我太重。
lines.en: I walk slowly because I am heavy.

lines.zh: 树根绊了我一下，我把它踩断。
lines.en: A root trips me, so I snap it underfoot.

lines.zh: 我在林子里拐弯，肩膀擦掉树皮。
lines.en: Turning in the wood, my shoulder strips bark.

lines.zh: 我走过河滩，水只到我的膝。
lines.en: I cross the riverbank and the water only reaches my knees.

lines.zh: 前面的灌木太密，我从上面跨过。
lines.en: The brush ahead is too thick, so I step over it.

lines.zh: 我卧在树荫里，背上的苔长得很好。
lines.en: I lie in the shade, and the moss on my back thrives.

lines.zh: 风吹过我的角，会发出低低的声音。
lines.en: Wind through my horns makes a low sound.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸一起一伏，落叶跟着动。
lines.en: My breathing rises and falls, and fallen leaves stir.

lines.zh: 我抬头看树冠，光从缝里漏下来。
lines.en: I look up at the canopy and light leaks through the gaps.

lines.zh: 丛林太吵，我反而睡得着。
lines.en: The jungle is loud, and that helps me sleep.

lines.zh: 我把下巴搁在树根上，等天黑。
lines.en: I rest my chin on a root and wait for dark.

lines.zh: 我身上的宝石偶尔会亮一下。
lines.en: The gem in my body glimmers now and then.

lines.zh: 我在数自己鳞上的裂纹。
lines.en: I am counting the cracks in my scales.

lines.zh: 树上有只鸟在骂我，我不理。
lines.en: A bird up there scolds me, and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩尾，把蚊虫赶走。
lines.en: I flick my tail to drive the gnats off.

lines.zh: 这片林子的味道我熟，每一棵都熟。
lines.en: I know this wood's smell, and every tree in it.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，林子静了一瞬。
lines.en: I yawn, and the forest goes quiet for a moment.

lines.zh: 我的角和树枝长得很像。
lines.en: My horns look very much like branches.

lines.zh: 雨落在背上，顺着鳞流进土里。
lines.en: Rain falls on my back and runs between scales into the soil.

lines.zh: 你站在树下，太矮了，我低了头。
lines.en: You stand under the tree, too short, so I lower my head.

lines.zh: 我先看你的手，再看你的斧。
lines.en: I look at your hands first, then your axe.

lines.zh: 你的气味很新，不是这片林子的。
lines.en: Your scent is new, not of this forest.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗处发着浅光。
lines.en: My eyes give off a pale light in the dark.

lines.zh: 你退了两步，树在你背后。
lines.en: You step back twice, and a tree is behind you.

lines.zh: 我侧过木角，让你看清我有多大。
lines.en: I turn my horns so you can see how large I am.

lines.zh: 你说话时，我的耳朵动了一下。
lines.en: When you speak, one of my ears moves.

lines.zh: 我盯着你脚下的蕨，那是我的。
lines.en: I stare at the ferns at your feet; those are mine.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我以为是食物。
lines.en: You raise a hand, and I think it is food.

lines.zh: 我看着你，像看一只走错路的鹿。
lines.en: I watch you like a deer that took a wrong path.

lines.zh: 你的火把在湿林里冒白烟。
lines.en: Your torch smokes white in the wet wood.

lines.zh: 我慢慢眨眼，这是我的礼节。
lines.en: I blink slowly; that is my courtesy.

lines.zh: 你的斧砍进我的腿，我跪了一下。
lines.en: Your axe bites my leg and I drop to one knee.

lines.zh: 我吼得树上的水都落下来了。
lines.en: I roar hard enough to shake water from the trees.

lines.zh: 血顺着鳞缝流，滴在蕨叶上。
lines.en: Blood runs between my scales and drips onto ferns.

lines.zh: 这一下不深，但让我记住了你。
lines.en: That cut is shallow, but I will remember you.

lines.zh: 我的角被砍出一道缺口。
lines.en: A notch is cut into my horn.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，撞断一根小树。
lines.en: I give half a step and snap a sapling.

lines.zh: 疼让我更快，不是更慢。
lines.en: Pain makes me faster, not slower.

lines.zh: 皮下的宝石闪了闪，像在回应。
lines.en: The gem under my hide flickers, as if answering.

lines.zh: 我低头看伤口，又抬头看你。
lines.en: I look down at the wound, then up at you.

lines.zh: 我这身重甲，也挡不住所有刀。
lines.en: Even my heavy hide cannot stop every blade.

lines.zh: 你手里的生肉，我闻到了。
lines.en: The raw meat in your hand, I smell it.

lines.zh: 我不会为一块肉低头太久。
lines.en: I will not bow my head long for one piece of meat.

lines.zh: 你把肉举高，那姿势很可笑。
lines.en: You hold the meat high, and the pose is absurd.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，又闭上，先看清你。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and look you over first.

lines.zh: 这点肉不够，但我可以等。
lines.en: That is not enough meat, but I can wait.

lines.zh: 我喜欢刚捕的，血还热的那种。
lines.en: I like it freshly caught, blood still warm.

lines.zh: 你把肉扔过来，它落进泥里。
lines.en: You toss the meat and it lands in the mud.

lines.zh: 我尝了尝，味道不像蜥蜴。
lines.en: I taste it; it is not like lizard.

lines.zh: 你手上有盐味，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: Your hands smell of salt, which I do not care for.

lines.zh: 若你常来，我会记得你的味道。
lines.en: Come often and I will remember your scent.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的腿，像撞一根柱子。
lines.en: You hit my leg like hitting a pillar.

lines.zh: 我的身体太宽，林间道不够走。
lines.en: My body is too wide for the forest path.

lines.zh: 我挪开半步，撞倒了三丛蕨。
lines.en: I shift half a step and flatten three ferns.

lines.zh: 你被我的尾巴扫到，坐在泥里。
lines.en: My tail catches you and you sit down in the mud.

lines.zh: 我不让路，树也不让。
lines.en: I will not yield, and neither will the tree.

lines.zh: 这一下把我撞得偏了头。
lines.en: That bump turns my head aside.

lines.zh: 你贴着我走，鳞片刮到你的肩。
lines.en: You walk close, and my scales scrape your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们挤在树缝里，谁都不好过。
lines.en: We squeeze into a gap between trees, both uncomfortable.

lines.zh: 我脚下打滑，压塌了一小片草。
lines.en: My foot slips and I flatten a patch of grass.

lines.zh: 你推我，我只把重心换了个脚。
lines.en: You push me, and I only shift my weight to another foot.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，林子显得更窄了。
lines.en: We walk side by side, and the wood seems narrower.

lines.zh: 她的角比我的光滑，是磨出来的。
lines.en: Her horns are smoother than mine, worn that way.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖碰她的颈，很轻。
lines.en: I touch her neck with my snout, very lightly.

lines.zh: 我们在林深处卧了一整夜。
lines.en: We lie in the deep wood for a whole night.

lines.zh: 我把捕获的猎物推到她面前。
lines.en: I push my catch in front of her.

lines.zh: 她的呼吸很重，和我的合上了拍。
lines.en: Her breathing is heavy and falls into rhythm with mine.

lines.zh: 两对木角在树影里交错。
lines.en: Two pairs of wooden horns cross in the tree shadows.

lines.zh: 她走了以后，那片草还是倒的。
lines.en: After she leaves, that grass stays flattened.

lines.zh: 我们把蛋埋在暖土里，用叶子盖好。
lines.en: We bury the eggs in warm soil and cover them with leaves.

lines.zh: 她叫一声，整片林子都听见了。
lines.en: She calls once, and the whole wood hears it.

lines.zh: 这块木头，我用角挑了起来。
lines.en: This piece of wood, I lift it with my horns.

lines.zh: 我叼起猎物，拖着走了半里。
lines.en: I take the catch in my jaws and drag it half a mile.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的宝石，我用爪子按住。
lines.en: The fallen gem, I pin it with a claw.

lines.zh: 太重的东西，我干脆坐上去。
lines.en: If a thing is too heavy, I simply sit on it.

lines.zh: 我把你掉的箭头舔进嘴里，又吐了。
lines.en: I lick your dropped arrowhead up, then spit it out.

lines.zh: 这根藤很适合磨角，我收着。
lines.en: This vine is good for rubbing horns; I keep it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一块骨头，闻了闻。
lines.en: I pick up a bone and sniff it.

lines.zh: 树倒下来，我把主干推到一边。
lines.en: The tree falls, and I shove the trunk aside.

lines.zh: 那些亮石头，我藏进树洞里。
lines.en: Those bright stones, I hide them in a hollow.

lines.zh: 我想把整棵树拔起来，没成功。
lines.en: I try to pull up a whole tree and fail.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的林子，脚步太响。
lines.en: You step into my wood, and your steps are too loud.

lines.zh: 我抬头，树影也跟着动。
lines.en: I raise my head, and the tree shadows move with it.

lines.zh: 你砍了一棵树，我听见了。
lines.en: You felled a tree, and I heard it.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，把路堵住。
lines.en: I turn slowly and block the path.

lines.zh: 你的火把让我看清了你的位置。
lines.en: Your torch shows me exactly where you are.

lines.zh: 我把前爪按进土里，准备冲。
lines.en: I dig my foreclaws into the soil, ready to charge.

lines.zh: 这片林子养我，我护它。
lines.en: This wood feeds me, so I guard it.

lines.zh: 你身上的血腥味飘过来了。
lines.en: The smell of blood drifts over from you.

lines.zh: 我吼了一声，鸟群全飞起来。
lines.en: I roar once, and every bird takes flight.

lines.zh: 你退到河边，那正是我想的。
lines.en: You retreat to the river, which is what I wanted.

lines.zh: 我不急，我的腿比你长。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; my legs are longer than yours.

lines.zh: 你举斧的样子，我见多了。
lines.en: I have seen many raise an axe at me.

lines.zh: 树挡着你，我绕过去就好。
lines.en: A tree blocks you, and I simply go around.

lines.zh: 这一声低吼，是最后一次提醒。
lines.en: This low growl is the last warning.

lines.zh: 你把斧头放下的那一刻，我动了。
lines.en: The moment you lowered your axe, I moved.

lines.zh: 林子里的鸟先跑，你才听见我。
lines.en: The birds fled first; only then did you hear me.

lines.zh: 我跟着你穿过蕨丛，一路压倒。
lines.en: I follow you through the ferns, flattening them.

lines.zh: 你往林子里钻，那正合我意。
lines.en: You duck into the wood, which suits me fine.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫平了你身后的路。
lines.en: My tail smooths the path behind you.

lines.zh: 你在树后躲，我从上面看。
lines.en: You hide behind a tree, and I look down from above.

lines.zh: 我一步顶你三步，不必跑。
lines.en: One of my steps equals three of yours; I need not run.

lines.zh: 河水挡不住我，我蹚过去。
lines.en: The river will not stop me; I wade through.

lines.zh: 你爬树，树枝撑不住你。
lines.en: You climb a tree, and the branch will not hold you.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的味道走，很准。
lines.en: I follow your scent, and I am accurate.

lines.zh: 你回头看，我就在那棵树旁。
lines.en: Look back; I am beside that tree.

lines.zh: 我绕着林子走，把你往空地赶。
lines.en: I circle the wood and drive you toward the clearing.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我还很稳。
lines.en: You are gasping, and I am still steady.

lines.zh: 我低吼一声，你的脚就慢了。
lines.en: I growl low, and your feet slow.

lines.zh: 这片林没有直路，只有我熟。
lines.en: This wood has no straight paths, and only I know them.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到崖边，风很大。
lines.en: I press you to the cliff edge, where the wind is strong.

lines.zh: 我一步一步来，脚下的土在陷。
lines.en: I come one step at a time, and the soil sinks under me.

lines.zh: 你背后的藤蔓，替我拦住你。
lines.en: The vines behind you hold you in place for me.

lines.zh: 我把头放低，角对着你的胸口。
lines.en: I lower my head, horns lined up with your chest.

lines.zh: 我一爪拍下去，土被掀起来。
lines.en: I bring a claw down and tear up the soil.

lines.zh: 木角顶中你的胸口，你飞了出去。
lines.en: My wooden horns catch your chest and you fly backward.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的肩，牙陷进皮甲。
lines.en: I bite your shoulder, teeth sinking into leather.

lines.zh: 尾巴横扫，把两棵树都打折了。
lines.en: My tail sweeps and snaps two trees.

lines.zh: 我压下去，你的骨头在响。
lines.en: I press down, and your bones creak.

lines.zh: 这一脚踩空了，但你还是倒了。
lines.en: The stomp misses, yet you still go down.

lines.zh: 我的头顶着你撞上树干。
lines.en: My head drives you into a tree trunk.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把你丢进蕨丛里。
lines.en: I throw my head and fling you into the ferns.

lines.zh: 你砍在我的角上，只留下白印。
lines.en: You chop my horn and leave only a white mark.

lines.zh: 我的宝石在皮下闪了一下。
lines.en: The gem under my hide flashes once.

lines.zh: 我张口，热气和血味一起出来。
lines.en: I open my mouth, and heat and blood smell come out.

lines.zh: 你滚开半步，我的爪跟着落。
lines.en: You roll half a step, and my claw follows.

lines.zh: 我一巴掌扫断你手里的斧柄。
lines.en: One swipe snaps the haft of your axe.

lines.zh: 这一下，你该记住这片林子。
lines.en: After this, you should remember this wood.

lines.zh: 我从林间的土里站起，树还在摇。
lines.en: I rise from the forest soil while the trees still sway.

lines.zh: 雨落在我刚长成的鳞上。
lines.en: Rain falls on my newly grown scales.

lines.zh: 我的木角先长出，然后才睁眼。
lines.en: My wooden horns grow first, and only then do I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 这片丛林让我落脚，我就留下。
lines.en: This jungle gives me footing, so I stay.

lines.zh: 我一站起来，树冠就到我肩下。
lines.en: When I stand, the canopy sits below my shoulder.

lines.zh: 土里的根缠过我的脚，我挣开了。
lines.en: Roots wound around my feet, and I broke free.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，惊飞一群鸟。
lines.en: I yawn and startle a flock of birds.

lines.zh: 我生来就沉，走一步陷半步。
lines.en: I am born heavy; each step sinks me half a step.

lines.zh: 林子里有我的味道了，很淡。
lines.en: My scent is in the wood now, very faint.

lines.zh: 我抬头找太阳，只看见叶子。
lines.en: I look up for the sun and see only leaves.

lines.zh: 脚下的蕨被我压平，我没有挪。
lines.en: The ferns flatten under me and I do not move.

lines.zh: 我的第一声吼，把林子震住了。
lines.en: My first roar stuns the whole wood.

lines.zh: 我从树影里出来，影子更大。
lines.en: I step out of the tree shade, and my shadow is larger.

lines.zh: 我身上的宝石，是那时亮起来的。
lines.en: The gem in my body lit up then.

lines.zh: 我落地时，整片林子往下沉。
lines.en: When I land, the whole forest floor sinks.

lines.zh: 木角先撞开一层树冠。
lines.en: My wooden horns shove through a layer of canopy first.

lines.zh: 火沿着我的鳞爬，林子也烧起来了。
lines.en: Fire crawls along my scales, and the wood burns too.

lines.zh: 从崖上落下，我砸出一个坑。
lines.en: Falling from the cliff, I make a crater.

lines.zh: 水盖过我的背，我往上游。
lines.en: Water closes over my back and I push upward.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻我，鳞片散了一地。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over and scales scatter.

lines.zh: 箭插进我的肩，像一根细刺。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder like a thin thorn.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进鳞缝，我的宝石暗了。
lines.en: Magic seeps between my scales and my gem darkens.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连树皮都啃。
lines.en: Hungry long enough, I gnaw even bark.

lines.zh: 雷落在我角上，整条脊背都亮。
lines.en: Lightning strikes my horn and my whole spine lights.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我的爪抓不住。
lines.en: In the void there is no soil for my claws.
